titles.title: Of inquiry requesting the President and directing the Secretary of Health and Human Services to transmit, respectively, certain documents to the House of Representatives relating to the freeze on State-based Temporary Assistance for Needy Families, Child Care and Development Fund, and Social Services Block Grant payments for California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota, and New York.

Of inquiry requesting the President and directing the Secretary of Health and Human Services to transmit, respectively, certain documents to the House of Representatives relating to the freeze on State-based Temporary Assistance for Needy Families, Child Care and Development Fund, and Social Services Block Grant payments for California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota, and New York.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

bill.summary:
This resolution requests that the President submit, and directs the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to submit, to the House of Representatives records, documents, and correspondence related to a freeze on payments to certain states under programs administered by the Administration for Children and Families.
(In January 2026, HHS froze funds under the Temporary Assistance for Needy Families [TANF], Social Services Block Grant, and Child Care and Development Fund programs for California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota, and New York. The freeze was rescinded in July 2026.)
